name: beginOAuth
description: Start the OAuth flow for an OAuth-backed provider. Two flow variants — distinguished by the returned `flow` field: `device-code` returns `{userCode, verificationUri, expiresIn}` for the WebUI to display while a background poll runs (used by GitHub Copilot, Qwen Code); `pkce` returns `{started: true}` and the C++ side opens the authorization URL in a normal browser window so the loopback redirect is captured by the OAuthRedirectThrottle. Replaces the chrome.send 'beginProviderOAuth' route.

inputs.name: providerId
inputs.description: OAuth provider id (chatgpt-pro, claude-pro, github-copilot, qwen-code, etc.)
